Writing Boot Camp
Writing Boot Camp, 8:30 to 10 a.m., Rehoboth library, 226 Rehoboth Ave., Rehoboth. Hosted by Rehoboth Beach Writers’ Guild, meet & socialize with other writers while working on ongoing projects. Go to rehoboth.lib.de.us for more information.
